name: "Grant To Handicrafts Societies" Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme
benefit:
- Grants to Handicrafts Societies for conducting exhibitions.
- PUDUMAI Handicrafts Artisans Society in Puducherry receives an annual grant of ₹10,00,000 for exhibition conduct.
- Other eligible societies receive ₹2,00,000 per annum for participating in exhibitions in and outside India for 5 years.
_eligibility_text:
- The Handicrafts Society should be registered either as a Co-operative society or under the Societies Act.
- Members of the society should be artisans approved either by the State Government or Development Commissioner (Handicrafts).
- The Society should exclusively deal with handicraft products produced by artisans of the UT of Puducherry.
